fields.speaker_opinion: It is a good place serving both Korean and Western food as well as signature drinks, where almost everything tastes delicious. Standout dishes include bouncy fish cake soup, chewy and addictive Tteokbokki, flavorful Aglio e Olio pasta, Caesar Salad, Kimbap, and drinks like Strawberry Smoothie and Cappuccino.
fields.notes: They also serve cold drinks at night.
